scope: Independent audit of previously frozen conditions only. No import or call to r003 raw_moments, no new condition, fit, time selection or full-round rerun.

independent_moment_reconstruction.method: Absolute-Gaussian arcsin formula for raw ReLU second moments, followed by an explicit affine transform matrix for trained centering/scaling and constant feature.

independent_quadrature_checks.method: 2D polar angular integration, distinct from production conditional-normal integration.
independent_quadrature_checks.target_method: Two independently integrated half-normal polynomial moments, applied to each saved feature coefficient.

all_condition_risk_recalculation.method: Raw augmented coefficient/Gram representation with explicit math.fsum scalar summation; stable bilinear delta.

interpretation_limits: Exact Gaussian-moment identities evaluated numerically for fixed saved weights; finite arithmetic error is explicitly checked.
Fifty positive changes are within this selected development set, not a prevalence estimate over future datasets or models.
The one negative population change is real for its two frozen times; its old empirical validation rise is not retained at population level.
All 51 population changes lie in old approximate MC intervals; this is descriptive calibration, not proof of interval coverage or formula correctness.
Only two frozen times are evaluated, not full trajectory monotonicity or a newly optimized stopping time.
No causal explanation of why noise-free rebound occurs is established.
